## About the Network

The EMPRESS Research Network is a multicenter, internationally collaborative clinical research network initiated by the Department of Critical Care Medicine, Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences and Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital. The network focuses on key scientific questions in septic shock, vasoplegia, and catecholamine-sparing therapy, and is committed to high-quality multicenter clinical trials, methodological support, data governance, and investigator training.

[Learn more &rarr;](about.html)

## Studies

<div class="study-card">
  <h3>EMPRESS Study<span class="tag">First study</span></h3>
  <p><strong>Early Methylene Blue for Mortality Reduction in High-Dose VasoPREssor-Dependent Septic Shock</strong> &mdash; an investigator-initiated, multicenter, open-label, blinded-endpoint randomized controlled trial (566 patients; primary outcome: 28-day all-cause mortality; registration: ChiCTR2500112352).</p>
  <p><a class="btn-dl primary" href="studies/empress.html">View study details</a></p>
</div>
